title: ACCEPTED
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring praise to God.

session.instruction: Open your door or your table to someone today — welcome them the way Jesus welcomed you, and thank God for the people He's placed in your life.

coaching_notes: Community requires cultivation. Just like you work on new skills in the gym or new recipes in the kitchen, community is an essential nutrient for a rich and satisfying life. So work on it.
